introHtml: Bioplastic lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a sustainable alternative to traditional petroleum-based products, made from renewable resources like corn or sugarcane. For marketing directors and HR leaders prioritizing eco-friendly swag, these items reduce environmental impact while providing durable, functional carryalls. The Adventure Lunch Bag and Igloo Repreve Lunch Pail Cooler showcase how bioplastic materials can be paired with recycled fabrics for a fully green product. Customize with your logo via screen printing or debossing to reinforce your commitment to sustainability.
